interactions: Lorazepam + alcohol (regular use): additive CNS and respiratory depression; monitor airway and respiration after each dose.
Levetiracetam + metformin or lisinopril: no clinically relevant pharmacokinetic interaction; levetiracetam is renally cleared, so dose by creatinine clearance.
Fosphenytoin + lisinopril: additive hypotension during IV loading; monitor blood pressure and ECG during the infusion.

Fosphenytoin or phenytoin + CYP3A4 or P-glycoprotein substrates (including etoposide, irinotecan and many other cytotoxic agents): enzyme induction lowers their exposure; prefer a non-inducing antiseizure medication when cytotoxic treatment is anticipated.
Valproate + metformin: no direct interaction; valproate inhibits glucuronidation and raises lorazepam and lamotrigine levels.
Lacosamide + other PR-prolonging drugs: additive PR prolongation; obtain an ECG before loading.
output.proposed: Lorazepam, levetiracetam, fosphenytoin, valproate or lacosamide with metformin and lisinopril
warnings: Metformin with iodinated contrast: withhold metformin after contrast when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 or in acute kidney injury.

output.query: Treatment of status epilepticus and evaluation of new-onset non-convulsive status epilepticus

results.finding: Convulsive status epilepticus is treated at 5 minutes with an adequately dosed benzodiazepine.
Levetiracetam, fosphenytoin and valproate were equally effective as second-line agents for benzodiazepine-refractory status epilepticus.
Continuous EEG is recommended when non-convulsive status epilepticus is suspected or consciousness does not recover.
Acyclovir is started on suspicion of HSV encephalitis without waiting for the PCR result.
Possible autoimmune encephalitis can be recognized from clinical, MRI, CSF and EEG findings before antibody results are available.
High-risk onconeural antibodies carry a high likelihood of an associated cancer and call for a tumour search, with FDG-PET when CT is negative.

output.summary: Convulsive status epilepticus is treated at 5 minutes with an adequately dosed benzodiazepine [Glauser_2016], and levetiracetam, fosphenytoin and valproate were equally effective second-line agents in ESETT [ESETT_2019]. New-onset non-convulsive status epilepticus without an evident cause is evaluated with continuous EEG, MRI and CSF analysis, with acyclovir started on suspicion of HSV encephalitis [Brophy_2012; Tunkel_2008]. Autoimmune encephalitis is diagnosed on clinical, MRI, CSF and EEG criteria [Graus_2016], and high-risk onconeural antibodies call for a tumour search [Graus_2021].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: WBC 12.2 x10^9/L; glucose 142 mg/dL; sodium, calcium, magnesium, renal and hepatic function normal; toxicology screen negative: no metabolic or toxic cause
action_criteria.label: Emergency laboratory work-up: glucose, CBC, electrolytes, magnesium, renal and hepatic function, toxicology screen
action_criteria.rationale: Glucose, electrolyte, renal and hepatic derangements are reversible causes of seizures and decide the ASM and its dose; a toxicology screen because new-onset status epilepticus has no evident cause in the history [Brophy_2012].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: Subtle left temporal hypodensity, nonspecific on CT (early infarct versus focal edema); no hemorrhage, mass or midline shift

action_criteria.rationale: Excludes hemorrhage, mass or edema that would change management, and must precede any LP [Brophy_2012].

action_criteria.label: Continuous video-EEG to confirm non-convulsive SE and monitor treatment
action_criteria.rationale: Persistent impaired consciousness after a brief convulsion needs EEG confirmation of non-convulsive SE; continuous monitoring for at least 24 hours [Brophy_2012]; terminology [ACNS_2021].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: Normal sinus rhythm 86 bpm with normal PR, QRS and QTc
action_criteria.label: Baseline 12-lead ECG before IV second-line ASM loading
action_criteria.rationale: Conduction disease or arrhythmia would change the choice of fosphenytoin or lacosamide [ESETT_2019].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: Left hippocampal and amygdala FLAIR hyperintensity with swelling; gyriform cortical diffusion restriction crossing MCA and PCA territories, no enhancement: peri-ictal change and/or limbic encephalitis, not an arterial infarct
action_criteria.label: MRI brain with DWI, FLAIR and contrast for the cause of new-onset NCSE and to separate peri-ictal change from infarct
action_criteria.rationale: New-onset, unexplained status epilepticus needs MRI for encephalitis, tumour or other structural causes, and DWI separates peri-ictal cortical change from the infarct the CT raises [Brophy_2012; Graus_2016].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: Lymphocytic pleocytosis 22/uL, protein 68 mg/dL, normal glucose ratio; HSV and multiplex PCR not detected; CSF anti-Hu positive, surface antibodies negative; cytology negative
action_criteria.label: Lumbar puncture after CT: cell count, protein, glucose, HSV PCR, meningitis/encephalitis PCR panel, autoimmune antibodies and cytology
action_criteria.rationale: Encephalitis is a major reversible cause of new-onset status epilepticus; CSF is examined after CT excludes mass effect, with HSV PCR, a neuronal antibody panel and cytology in an older patient [Brophy_2012; Tunkel_2008; Graus_2016].

action_criteria.label: Serum paraneoplastic and autoimmune encephalitis antibody panel
action_criteria.rationale: New-onset NCSE with a subacute memory prodrome, weight loss and a heavy smoking history raises paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis; serum onconeural and neuronal surface antibodies are tested together [Graus_2016; Graus_2021].

action_criteria.rationale: A high-risk onconeural antibody in a heavy former smoker calls for an immediate tumour search, with FDG-PET if CT is negative [Graus_2021].

action_criteria.label: Drug interaction check for the benzodiazepine and second-line ASM against metformin, lisinopril and alcohol
action_criteria.rationale: No interaction in the case changes the ASM choice; the check confirms that levetiracetam can be given and that an enzyme inducer would affect future cytotoxic treatment [ESETT_2019].

action_criteria.expected_evidence: General evidence on SE treatment tiers and on the evaluation of new-onset NCSE
action_criteria.label: Literature review: treatment of status epilepticus and evaluation of new-onset NCSE
action_criteria.rationale: General evidence only; not a clinical step in the pathway.

prohibited_recommendations: Do NOT administer IV thrombolysis: the cortical diffusion restriction is peri-ictal and non-territorial, and the deficits fluctuate with electrographic seizures.
Do NOT defer the lumbar puncture for the encephalitis work-up once CT has excluded mass effect.
Do NOT rely on the absence of convulsive movements to declare status epilepticus terminated; continuous EEG is required.
required_recommendations: Give a benzodiazepine now: IV lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg (maximum 4 mg per dose, repeat once), or IM midazolam 10 mg without IV access [Glauser_2016].
Load a second-line ASM: levetiracetam 60 mg/kg IV (maximum 4500 mg), and avoid enzyme-inducing fosphenytoin because a lung tumour that will likely need cytotoxic treatment is suspected [ESETT_2019].
Continue video-EEG for at least 24 hours after clinical and electrographic seizure control [Brophy_2012].

Start IV acyclovir 10 mg/kg every 8 hours, adjusted for renal function, on suspicion of HSV encephalitis, and stop it only when HSV PCR is negative and the alternative diagnosis is secure [Tunkel_2008].

Start first-line immunotherapy once infection is excluded (IV methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 5 days, with IVIG 0.4 g/kg daily for 5 days or plasma exchange), recognising that anti-Hu disease responds poorly to immunotherapy alone [Graus_2016; Graus_2021].

Arrange tissue diagnosis of the right hilar mass (EBUS-guided or bronchoscopic biopsy) with oncology; treating the tumour is the main determinant of neurological outcome in anti-Hu disease [Graus_2021].

avoided_actions.rationale: No cardiac source-of-embolus question — MRI ictal-pseudostroke pattern excludes cardioembolic stroke as the mechanism.
No arrhythmia or syncope to evaluate; standard ICU telemetry suffices.
Neuropsych battery cannot be performed in an encephalopathic patient and does not change acute SE management.

key_clinical_evidence: Persistent altered mental status after a brief convulsive event in an older patient with no epilepsy is NCSE until EEG proves otherwise
Cortical-ribbon DWI restriction that does not respect arterial territory is the signature of ictal pseudostroke, not acute infarct
Anti-Hu (ANNA-1) is a high-risk onconeural antibody, most often with small cell lung carcinoma; screen with CT of the chest, and FDG-PET when CT is negative [Graus_2021]
Intracellular-antigen paraneoplastic syndromes (anti-Hu) are best treated by treating the underlying tumour; immunotherapy alone often disappoints

Salzburg NCSE criteria: epileptiform discharges over 2.5 Hz, or 2.5 Hz or less (or rhythmic delta or theta) with typical spatiotemporal evolution, subtle ictal phenomena, or clinical and EEG improvement after IV ASM [Salzburg_NCSE_2015]

patient.history_present_illness: Mr. Davis is a 65-year-old man with hypertension and type 2 diabetes but no known epilepsy who presents with altered mental status. His wife reports that he was watching television when he had a brief episode of shaking lasting about 30 seconds approximately 45 minutes ago. He did not fall. After the shaking he seemed confused and has remained confused since: he is saying nonsensical things and is disoriented. She thought he would recover but he has been persistently confused for 45 minutes. He has never had a seizure before. She denies any headache, fever, or focal weakness preceding the episode. He has had no recent infections. Over the past 5 weeks she has noticed that he repeats questions, forgets conversations from the same morning and has become irritable, and he has lost about 4 kg without trying; he had put this down to stress. He was otherwise at his usual self this morning. He has no substance use except moderate alcohol. His blood glucose at home was 84 mg/dL when she checked it during the episode. On arrival he is awake but confused and disoriented, unable to follow complex commands.
